treatment_rationale.summary: An oral HER2-directed kinase inhibitor plus fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy for previously treated HER2-positive advanced breast cancer. Lapatinib acts inside the cell; capecitabine supplies a different cytotoxic mechanism.
treatment_rationale.line: After anthracycline, taxane and trastuzumab exposure under the NCCP indication; not a first-line metastatic default.
factors: Confirm HER2 testing and the full prior HER2-treatment sequence; oral delivery alone is not a reason to prefer this regimen.
Review DPD status, renal function, diarrhoea, hand–foot symptoms, liver/cardiac risk, interactions and ability to follow two different tablet schedules.
Discuss treatment burden and goals, including the need to continue lapatinib through the capecitabine rest week.
alternatives: Compare other eligible HER2-directed options with the MDT using prior exposure, CNS involvement, organ function and current Irish access.
Do not infer superiority to current antibody-drug conjugate or tucatinib-based options from a trial whose control was capecitabine alone.
treatment_rationale.limitations: Selection requires the exact current NCCP indication, prior treatment, individual fitness and local access review. Historical trial results do not establish a universal preferred sequence.

treatment_rationale.summary: This card specifies the dual HER2-antibody component of an early-breast pathway. The chemotherapy backbone must be selected separately; it is not an interchangeable complete chemotherapy prescription.
treatment_rationale.setting: Neoadjuvant high-risk HER2-positive disease, or the separately specified adjuvant high-risk indication
treatment_rationale.line: Early-breast treatment; select neoadjuvant versus adjuvant context before interpreting the pathway.
factors: Use stage, nodal risk and fitness rather than HER2 positivity alone to justify dual blockade.
Complete anthracyclines before starting the antibodies; when using a taxane, begin antibodies with its first cycle.
NCCP v3 lists adjuvant pertuzumab reimbursement as not approved. Verify current access separately; efficacy evidence is not an access authorization.
alternatives: A regimen-specific TCHP or TRAIN-2 card provides the actual chemotherapy dose, monitoring and supportive-care plan.
Postoperative treatment depends on pathology and the selected current regimen; do not automatically copy the preoperative chemotherapy plan.
treatment_rationale.limitations: Selection requires the exact current NCCP indication, prior treatment, individual fitness and local access review. Historical trial results do not establish a universal preferred sequence.

treatment_rationale.setting: HER2-positive metastatic / locally recurrent unresectable breast cancer
treatment_rationale.line: First-line metastatic context; document the taxane-unsuitability reason and prior metastatic treatment restriction.
factors: Confirm HER2 positivity, disease-control goals and why docetaxel is unsuitable or not tolerated.
Assess marrow reserve, constipation/ileus, neuropathy, liver and cardiac function; a different chemotherapy does not mean risk-free treatment.
Explain the Day 1/Day 8 visits and any first-cycle staggered administration. Follow the regimen-specific unlicensed-use consent requirement.
alternatives: Taxane-based dual blockade has a different evidence base; VELVET does not prove vinorelbine equivalent or superior.
Administration route is a practical choice subject to eligibility; it does not imply added survival.
treatment_rationale.limitations: Selection requires the exact current NCCP indication, prior treatment, individual fitness and local access review. Historical trial results do not establish a universal preferred sequence.

treatment_rationale.summary: An anthracycline-free paclitaxel/carboplatin strategy with IV dual HER2 blockade before surgery. Selection balances recurrence risk, cardiac considerations, renal dosing, neuropathy and visit burden.
treatment_rationale.setting: HER2-positive locally advanced, inflammatory or high-risk early breast cancer
treatment_rationale.line: Neoadjuvant; NCCP specifies six cycles, then surgery and a separate postoperative decision.
factors: Confirm stage and HER2 result; treatment intensity should fit disease risk and fitness.
Day 1 and Day 8 visits differ from three-weekly docetaxel TCHP.
Surgical pathology guides further HER2 treatment; endocrine treatment and radiotherapy depend on the complete plan.
alternatives: TCHP uses a different taxane schedule. The studies cannot be ranked by cross-trial pCR percentages.
Anthracycline-containing options have additional toxicity considerations; omit or use them through an individual MDT decision.
treatment_rationale.limitations: Selection requires the exact current NCCP indication, prior treatment, individual fitness and local access review. Historical trial results do not establish a universal preferred sequence.

evidence_at_a_glance.population: 438 patients with stage II–III HER2-positive disease.
evidence_at_a_glance.comparison: Nine paclitaxel/carboplatin cycles versus three FEC then six paclitaxel/carboplatin cycles; both used IV HER2 antibodies.
evidence_at_a_glance.applicability: The NCCP course has six cycles; the original non-anthracycline trial course had nine. Trial outcomes are strategy evidence, not direct six-cycle efficacy estimates.

endpoints.definition: ypT0/is ypN0: no invasive breast or nodal disease; breast in-situ disease permitted.
endpoints.interpretation: No demonstrated pCR advantage from adding anthracyclines (P=.95).

sources.label: TRAIN-2 · van Ramshorst et al., Lancet Oncology 2018

endpoints.limitations: Different treatment duration from NCCP 00775; no proof that shorter treatment has identical efficacy.

endpoints.definition: Progression causing inoperability, recurrence, second primary cancer or death; excludes contralateral DCIS.
endpoints.interpretation: No demonstrated difference; not proof of survival equivalence.

sources.label: TRAIN-2 · van der Voort et al., JAMA Oncology 2021

endpoints.limitations: Underpowered for survival equivalence; postoperative management has evolved.

evidence_at_a_glance.harms: Anthracyclines added febrile-neutropenia and cardiac risks. The non-anthracycline arm still had clinically important cytopenias, diarrhoea and neuropathy.
limitations: Do not silently extend NCCP treatment to nine cycles or attribute trial survival to its six-cycle course.
pCR is not a cure rate.

treatment_rationale.summary: Docetaxel provides cytotoxic treatment alongside two complementary HER2 antibodies. The randomized evidence concerns induction followed by antibody continuation, which should be explained as distinct phases.
treatment_rationale.setting: HER2-positive metastatic / locally recurrent unresectable breast cancer
treatment_rationale.line: No prior chemotherapy or anti-HER2 therapy for metastatic disease under the NCCP indication.
factors: Review validated HER2 status, previous treatment, disease symptoms and docetaxel fitness.
Balance marrow, liver, neuropathy and cardiac risks; agree when chemotherapy will be reviewed.
Maintenance retains HER2 monitoring but does not retain every docetaxel premedication or cytotoxic effect.
alternatives: Weekly paclitaxel or vinorelbine may be considered under their own NCCP eligibility and consent requirements when docetaxel is unsuitable.
Newer HER2 strategies require contemporary sequencing and access review; CLEOPATRA is historical evidence, not a comparison against all current options.
treatment_rationale.limitations: Selection requires the exact current NCCP indication, prior treatment, individual fitness and local access review. Historical trial results do not establish a universal preferred sequence.

alternatives: Anthracycline/taxane/trastuzumab is a different option with different cardiac/leukaemia risks.

treatment_rationale.limitations: Selection requires the exact current NCCP indication, prior treatment, individual fitness and local access review. Historical trial results do not establish a universal preferred sequence.
